AND c.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.companyName}, '%')
AND jp.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.title}, '%')
AND (jp.location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.location}, '%') OR c.location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.location}, '%'))
